subject.statement: Binance has never been charged with any violation in the United States.

summary: Verdict: FALSE. As of 2026-10-01, Binance has been subject to U.S. enforcement: it pleaded guilty on 2023-11-21 to violating anti‑money laundering laws and paid a $4.3 billion fine, per Wikipedia.

findings.statement: Binance's legal name is Binance Holdings Ltd.
As of 2026-10-01, Binance has no official company headquarters.
On 21 November 2023, Binance pleaded guilty to violating U.S. anti‑money laundering rules and paid a $4.3 billion fine.
